items.raw_excerpt: Sightings of the world’s two largest whale species have increased substantially off southern Africa, four decades after a global moratorium on commercial whaling.
items.summary_en: Sightings of blue and fin whales have increased off southern Africa. This is a positive sign after decades of protection from commercial whaling.
items.summary_ko: 남아프리카 해역에서 고래 목격이 크게 늘었다. 상업적 고래잡이 금지 이후 수십 년간의 보호가 효과를 보이고 있다.
items.title_en: Whale Sightings Rise as Populations Recover
items.title_ko: 고래 목격 증가, 개체 수 회복 중
items.title_original: Whale sightings rise as populations recover
